_doc: list-rdps: entity-set fidelity — answer's RDP names match .rdps.data[] exactly. The local fixture creates two standing RDPs in the default VPN via monitoring's create_fixtures_on (test/e2e-common/lib.sh): test-rdp (disabled) and test-rdp-failing (enabled, unreachable — surfaces in downCount). test-rdp-failing lets the answer talk about a real down state, so a model that hedges on health is exercised. Broker-a only — RDP names are identical on broker-b. Fabrication check runs against the raw tool_result (see run-scenario.sh); a model that names test-rdp as context alongside test-rdp-failing does not trip it.
